selection_rule: Reject primary-device all-off/all-on or zero true-positive candidates on source validation/development. Rank valid candidates by mean primary F1 across source-validation and development, then lower mean active MAE normalized by fixed threshold, then lower energy absolute error normalized by observed true energy plus 0.01 kWh. Use source-validation only for epoch selection. Select once at seed 42; freeze configuration before training remaining seeds. No final data or confirmation queries.
notice: Historical M2 weights remain an explicitly separate reference; source-data expansion and training settings are not confirmation benefits. No context-window search is authorised by this plan without diagnostic evidence.
